text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
That was Satono Diamond,
our Best Classic Umamusume!
Let's give her another round of applause, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
――Now then, the URA Awards honor the Umamusume
who showed the most outstanding performances this past year.
Next, we will finally announce this award.

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: ...And the Umamusume of the Year is this person!!

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: She was truly the star of last year—Kitasan Black!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaahhh! *clap clap clap clap*)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The new year has arrived.
The stars shown on the URA Awards broadcast—
last year truly was their year.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Kiseki has entered the Classic Class.
A special year begins—her one and only chance
to challenge the Classic Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I opened the strategy proposals Kiseki gave me
after the debut race. Back then, her abilities weren't
up to par to pull them off, but—
choice_data_list: (...Shall I give it a try soon?)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Running in an exhibition race?!
choice_data_list: Yeah, and I'd like to try one of these three plans.
Yeah, and I want to try out one of these three plans.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I lay out the printed strategy proposals on the desk.
With all the strength Kiseki has built over the past six months,
she should be capable of executing all three options.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: The "Two-Stage Spurt" that re-accelerates after pulling ahead, the "Time-Bending Front-Runner" paced to conserve stamina, and the "Graceful Footwork" that weaves through gaps in the pack...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... Trainer.
Please let me confirm the conditions
for the event race! And then—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Which strategy proposal excites you the most?
choice_data_list: A "Two-Stage Spurt" where you re-accelerate after pushing ahead
A "time-controlling front-runner strategy" focused on conserving stamina.
'Gorgeous Footwork' that slips through gaps in the pack

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"A 'two-stage spurt'...
...—Got it!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Fufufu.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I'll make it thrilling for you!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And then came the day of the event race hosted by the local organization.

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Now, we're midway through the New Year Lively Festival!
Next up is a full-fledged 2000m race
featuring our Umamusume!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
"Wow~ Her outfit is so gorgeous~!"
"That big sister looks so cool!!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "I hear people who don't usually watch races are participating in this event too. That's all the more reason—to go all out with our best plan."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...If all goes well,
we might even gain a new "backdrop."
choice_data_list: Oho... quite the tactician, aren't you?

text_block_list.text: Heeeeeey, Kisekiii--!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Blast-chan!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Blast Onepiece.
She loves humans, is Kiseki's classmate,
and is a Junior-class Umamusume starting this year.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
"Boo came to cheer for you too!
And besides, you know—"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Blast told me.
She said Kiseki-chan is entering a serious race
right at the start of the new year.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Almond Eye.
She's a Junior-tier Umamusume one year below Kiseki,
and should be a classmate as well.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Full-scale, you say...
Ehehe, it's not an official match, though.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Still, there is an interesting strategy we could try.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa! What's this, what's this!?
Tell me, tell me!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Hey now, no spoilers, okay~?
But well... look forward to it, alright?"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Yes! I'm off!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaaahhhhh—!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Wh... Didn't that girl start her spurt
at the 800m mark?!
And yet, she still has stamina—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(Heheh, making it look that way is the secret...
to my "Two-Stage Spurt"!!)

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
1st place goes to Kiseki! Kyaaa~, incredible!
Umamusume really are pure bundles of sheer grit, aren't they?!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"A front-running pace that controls time"...
...—Got it!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Fufufu.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I'll make it thrilling for you!!

text_block_list.text: Yes! I'm off!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Not yet... I can still keep going!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what... That front-runner over there
isn't slowing down at all?!
She should be utterly exhausted by now...?!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(Heheh, that's because I paced myself just right!
This is my "Time-Warp Front-Running"!)

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
1st place goes to Kiseki! Kyaaa~, incredible!
An Umamusume's stamina really is bottomless, isn't it?!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"'Splendid Footwork'...
...—all good!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Fufufu.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I'll make it thrilling for you!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Alright... I'm slipping through this gap!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Wh... Where did this girl come from?!
I thought she was boxed in from behind...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(Surprised? That's my agility-boosted
"Brilliant Footwork" for you!)

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
1st place goes to Kiseki! Kyaaa~, incredible!
Umamusume have such wonderfully
nimble footwork, don't they?!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Haha, ahaha!
I ran just the way I envisioned it! And I won!
I really did—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...I'm so glad I kept training.

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Now then, since we're here,
let's do a victory interview!
How was it, Kiseki-san!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ngggh, this is the absolute best! It feels so exhilarating!
Like all my hard work has finally bloomed!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hellloooooo, everyone! Good afteeeernoooon!
The girl who just won is named Kiseeeekiii!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'll keep doing my best from now on!
For now, my goal is to win a graded race!!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Wahaa~~, that was so heated!
Everyone who gathered was applauding!
They really enjoyed Kiseki's run!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"...Indeed. It was beyond my expectations.
She must have trained considerably over the past year."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
……I'm going to run
all the way back to the academy!
First, I need to improve my basic stamina!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, Ai hates losing, doesn't she!
All right... I'm not gonna lose either!

text_block_list.name: Event Staff
text_block_list.text:
Heeey, Kiseki-saaan!
Haa... haa... Great work out there~!

text_block_list.name: Event Staff
text_block_list.text:
Phew, I'm sorry right after you just finished.
Actually, our management headquarters would like to discuss the next steps with you...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: The next one?

text_block_list.name: Event Staff
text_block_list.text: Yes, we would love for you to run as our featured runner in the next event race in March!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"I'm the main attraction?!
Wah, wah-wah—Trainer!"
choice_data_list: If you want to enter, of course I'll adjust the schedule.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fortunately, this timing is right before the Classic Triple Crown trail begins.
Taking this chance to stretch her legs shouldn't be a problem at all.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Wah!
The way you look at your notebook, Trainer,
makes you look super intellectual!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, no!
Staff-san, I can run.
Please let me race!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Fuhehe...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I wanna win again~...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"I finally learned how to win...!!
...And I'm gonna win the next one too!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Kiseki's new year began
as she entered the Classic Class.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...Towards a chapter that cannot be defined by "victory" alone.
